plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.S. in Mathematics, McCausland College of Arts and Sciences, Dept. of Mathematics, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_math_map.pdf). All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (16/16/15/15/15/12/15/14 at slot minimums = 118 total; official degree minimum 120 per Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 21 major, 53-65 college/program, 34-46 Carolina Core, 2.000 GPA — range slots/electives fill to 120+). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: Carolina Core Req (3-4) at 3; Foreign language/other CC (3-4) at 3; CSCE 145 (4) vs CSCE 106 (3) at 3; 'Elective' (2-3) at 2. MATH Major Electives: 15+ hrs of MATH 500-599. 12-hr advanced cognate or 18+ hr minor (C or higher in minor courses); foreign language proficiency equivalent to the 122 course; one U.S. + one non-U.S. History required. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
